edges.reason: transfer() forwards _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
manualswap authorizes with require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1) instead of onlyOwner.
manualsend authorizes with require(_msgSender() == _feeAddrWallet1) instead of onlyOwner.
_transfer enforces cooldown[to] < block.timestamp, making behavior timestamp dependent.
cooldown[to] is written as block.timestamp + 30 seconds.
swapTokensForEth passes block.timestamp as the swap deadline.
openTrading passes block.timestamp as the liquidity deadline.
openTrading is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setBots is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
delBot is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
setCooldownEnabled is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
renounceOwnership is protected by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
approve calls _approve.
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection reads the rate from _getRate.
_getRate divides supplies returned by _getCurrentSupply.
External swap is executed inside _transfer before _tokenTransfer updates balances.
ETH payout occurs before the sender/recipient reflection balances are updated.
_transfer finishes with _tokenTransfer.
_transfer compares from/to with uniswapV2Pair to decide fee and swap paths.
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee before applying fees or cooldown.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount on buys.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard set by lockTheSwap to prevent recursive swapping.
_transfer checks swapEnabled before swapping and paying out.
_transfer checks cooldownEnabled before applying the cooldown branch.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap.
swapTokensForEth approves the router through _approve.
swapTokensForEth calls uniswapV2Router.WETH and the swap entrypoint.
sendETHToFee performs the ETH transfers to the fee wallets.
openTrading calls addLiquidityETH with the full contract ETH balance.
openTrading calls factory createPair and stores the result.
openTrading grants a max approval to the router on the pair.
openTrading assigns uniswapV2Router from the hardcoded router address.
openTrading assigns the created pair to uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading lowers _maxTxAmount to 50000000000 * 10**9.
manualswap externally triggers swapTokensForEth without a reentrancy guard.
manualsend externally triggers sendETHToFee without a reentrancy guard.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard takes the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds _rOwned balances for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam credits _rOwned[address(this)].
_takeTeam multiplies tTeam by the local currentRate.
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal.
_getValues calls _getTValues.
_getValues calls _getRValues with the current rate.
_getValues passes _feeAddr1 as the tax fee.
_getValues passes _feeAddr2 as the team fee.
setBots marks each supplied address in bots.
delBot clears the bots flag for an address.
setCooldownEnabled writes the cooldownEnabled flag.
renounceOwnership clears _owner.
Half of the ETH is sent to _feeAddrWallet1.
Half of the ETH is sent to _feeAddrWallet2.
_rTotal is derived from _tTotal at construction.
from parameter drives owner/pair comparisons in _transfer.
to parameter drives cooldown, bot and fee checks in _transfer.
amount parameter is validated and then transferred.
tokenAmount parameter is the swap input amount.
amount parameter is split by two and sent to the fee wallets.
spender parameter is written into _allowances.
amount parameter is written into _allowances.
bots_ list is iterated to flag addresses.
notbot address has its bot flag cleared.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is used for the allowance subtraction.
onoff parameter is stored into cooldownEnabled.
rAmount parameter is divided by the current rate.
contract token balance is passed into the external swap before balances are settled.
contract ETH balance is passed to sendETHToFee.
currentRate local is produced by _getRate.
rTeam is added to _rOwned[address(this)].
path local is supplied to the external router swap.
local router instance is stored into uniswapV2Router.
The router swap triggers fee-on-transfer token transfers that re-enter _transfer.
Swap ETH output is sent to this contract and enters receive().
ETH transfers to wallet addresses can land in a contract that re-enters receive().
addLiquidityETH payable flow returns ETH to this contract through receive().
addLiquidityETH moves this token, re-entering _transfer during liquidity provisioning.
